[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: Determination of Tax in Certain Special Cases
 Section: 113::Tax in the case of block assessment of search cases.
]


The total 24[undisclosed] income of the block period, determined under section 158BC, shall be chargeable to tax at the rate of sixty per cent:
Provided that the tax chargeable under this section shall be increased by a surcharge, if any, levied by any Central Act 25[***].
